'''Happiness''' is a mechanic. Can be viewed anytime under the energy bar, with the icon {{Icon|Happiness|size=20}}. It is directly related to the [[Church]], as it determines the maximum number of attendees at a sermon. The maximum number depends on the {{Icon|Town Quality|size=20}}  Town Quality, which can be viewed at any time in the [[Town]].

== Obtaining ==
* {{Item|Town Gratitude}} gives {{Icon|Happiness|5}}
* Selling items to traders.

== Town Quality ==
The [[Keeper]] can increase the {{Icon|Town Quality|size=20}} Town Quality by talking to [[Linda]] and exchanging {{Item|Green Scroll}}, which are obtained by repairing houses in the Town.
